name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines, fostered by his father's work as a mechanic. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from the Budapest University of Technology and Economics, specializing in precision manufacturing and quality assurance. Before joining 23XI Racing, Zoltán spent several years at a high-end automotive component supplier, where he honed his skills in identifying and resolving manufacturing defects, ensuring components met stringent performance requirements.

At 23XI, Zoltán is responsible for the rigorous inspection of car parts and assemblies, utilizing advanced testing techniques and data analysis to maintain the team's competitive edge. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his proactive approach to problem-solving. Zoltán believes in continuous improvement and consistently seeks innovative ways to optimize quality control processes, contributing to the team's overall performance and reliability on the track. He's particularly adept at spotting subtle deviations from specifications that could impact performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a focused gaze and a serious demeanor.
